scope: Incremental static read guard; only migrated boundaries, not a whole-repository World ban or a complete JavaScript analyzer

compatibilityDebt.TerrainReadView: this.world[name] is restricted by existing TERRAIN_LAYERS; initial/overflow copies and changed rectangles only. Actual Canvas/Three terrain upload retains existing World/terrainChanges facade.
compatibilityDebt.Canvas drawEntities: Managed entity drawing uses committed geometry/faction snapshots, with no canonical list fallback. Unmanaged standalone fixtures may read original geometry only.
compatibilityDebt.Three deriveEntities: All visual facts come from same-generation frame; explicit refresh only for unmanaged standalone fixtures.
compatibilityDebt.Query: Settlement card remains a legacy transitive read; rejects in-progress/fault/disposed managed Worlds.
compatibilityDebt.Other main/G1/Camera/Presentation/UI: Unmigrated reads and authoritative observation/commands remain listed in READ_SURFACE; no global prohibition.
